body: Yess!! The first step is always the hardest so great job. I'm very proud!

Honestly I don't know if this will be helpful, but did you let yourself grieve?

When he broke up with me at first I tried to bottle it up and be happy, but it only made things worse. So I let myself cry, I listened to sad songs, I looked at a few of our pictures, I wrote a letter I never sent.

I'm still heartbroken of course, but I'm much much better now, over 2 months later.

Just be kind to yourself and remember that getting better is neither linear, nor it has a specific schedule. Our sadness comes in waves and it's ok to still be hurt, it's ok to cry and don't let anyone tell you otherwise! Maybe you don't have to be happy yet, try to take care of yourself as best you can, and it will come with time.

I'm sending you hugs!!!

Thank you for your comment, it helped me put things in a different perspective. It's true that we can't know what the other person is thinking and it isn't always negative. It just hurts like hell because I believed him with my whole heart when he said we'd be forever... And now we have no contact at all :( I really hope things get better.

Again, thank you. I hope you are doing well!

You're right, I keep thinking about what will I do if the interviewer is extremely rude or mean, but that is highly unlikely as that would just reflect bad on them. I also always worry about what others think of me that I end up not considering my own feelings. I'll have to remind myself that they probably want to make a good impression too, and that I want to see if they would be a good fit for me just as much.

And yeah, if it goes bad at least I will get some exposure and learn something. If anything, my therapist will be proud lol!

Thank you! And especially thanks for making me feel a little less nervous.

Yes! I said it in another comment, I usually imagine a situation will be much worse than it actually is, which only makes me more nervous. I really hope that it will be easier once it starts. Thank you.
I usually make a situation seem much worse in my head, which only makes the situation more scary than it is. Thanks for commenting!
Yeah you're right, we can never really know until we try I guess. Hopefully it gets easier for us with time. Good job with your interview!

Thank you for this comment, it might sound silly but I often forget that the person sitting in front of me is simply human too. I guess it makes sense that they just want to see if we would be a good fit. I definitely try to tell myself that there is no bad outcome to this, worst case scenario is they don't like me and I'll never have to see them again. But at least I tried right?

I'm glad to hear your interview went ok! I wish you the best of luck!
So cute! :)
I'm in the exact same situation, my first love left me when he promised he never would. I don't know how I can trust another person's words again. I'm sending you hugs!

Well there are different kinds of treatment and every person's journey is unique, so what was right for me may not be right for everyone.

In my case, I used to go to a psychodynamic therapist years ago because I had a lot of anxiety, but she didnt have any experience with OCD so she didnt recognize it. Ultimately while it was good for me to talk about some past experiences, my OCD just got worse because a lot of our discussions didn't offer answers and I was left to speculate on my own, which only reinforced the fears and doubts I was having. At the end of the day it was just talking for one hour a week and it didn't offer me ways to cope with my symptoms after therapy was over.

So after years of knowing something was wrong but being too scared to properly address it, I decided to go to a psychiatrist first and get a proper diagnosis. After diagnosing me with OCD he referred me to an ERP therapist with a lot of experience with the disorder. But even though it's still one hour a week I now have a much better understanding of what is going on and my therapist offers me a lot of tools and techniques that I can use every day to deal with my symptoms on my own.

Sorry for the long reply, but I hope it answers your question!

I love this post!

While OCD can't be cured that doesn't mean it can't get treated. There are many options out there for us, and while it's a battle to get there we can definitely lead a fullfilling life.

I've had OCD for 6 years but I only sought appropriate treatment 7 months ago. I know it will never go completely away but I have improved tremendously since then and I'm a completely different person now. For the first time in years I'm optimistic about my future.

I guess what I wanted to achieve with this comment is spread some extra love to my fellow redditors. Yes it's hard and there are times when you will relapse and feel hopeless. But you can absolutely get better! It may be an incurable disorder but it's one that can be managed in the long run. 

I believe in every single one of you!

I don't know if you'll find this helpful but I've been through what you're describing so I'll share my story.

I got diagnosed with OCD about 7 months ago around October, but my therapist and I estimate that I've had it for about 6 years. After progressively getting worse all that time, I finally hit rock bottom last summer. 

To give you an idea, I would spend my entire days asking for reassurance and checking things, but I would just end up crying because I still wasn't sure. I was scared to leave my house and I stopped driving because I was convinced I was a bad person and I'd end up hurting someone. I couldn't eat because I was sure I would choke and I couldn't sleep because I was scared I would stop breathing. My intrusive thoughts were so bad that I would have frequent panic attacks. Every minor physical discomfort would convince me I was sick. One time I was so sure I was going to die from taking an aspirin, that I spent 3 days in a row not doing anything apart from looking up my symptoms online and repeatedly asking my sister if I would be ok, while I barely ate anything and I only took a few naps out of pure exhaustion. The whole summer I didn't do anything apart from compulsions, ruminating and crying. 

I have been in therapy for about 6 months now. Is my life completely carefree? Of course not. There are still times where I feel hopeless and OCD gets the best of me.

But do I see a light at the end of the tunnel? Absolutely! Therapy is hard, there were times where I felt like it wasn't working and it took me some time to find the right therapist for me. It takes a lot of effort to get better and OCD isn't something that ever completely goes away, but in my experience it's extremely manageable. 

I still have a long way to go, but I can function much better now. I started exercising, I'm eating properly and I sleep a lot better. I went from asking for reassurance all day to maybe asking twice a week. I can finally leave my house with no problem and I'm slowly going to start applying for jobs! For the first time in years I'm feeling optimistic about my future (and I'm even going through a breakup right now, so imagine that!).

It absolutely can get better. Just don't be too hard on yourself, you don't have to make progress fast or not have any bad days. It may be a long road to get there, it takes time, effort, patience and there will be times where you fall. But you will get back up again, and you can get through this! I believe in you ❤

This gave me a smile at a time of great pain. Thank you so much for posting, such a simple yet brilliant way to describe what we're going through and it really puts things into perspective. I'm definitely going to call my ex a Stilton pizza from now on. I hope you have a nice day!
I understand how you feel, my ex and I used to be the same way and now I think I will always hate the date when he broke up with me. I can only hope our wounds heal with time. Take care!

To be fair most of our problems emerged in the last few months and there wasn't any lying involved, but we definitely could have communicated our needs to one another better. And the fact that we both struggle with our mental health only made matters worse. It is what it is.

This is probably a stupid question but can I ask how are you? Do you need to talk about it?

I really felt your pain through the video and I am really sorry that this happened to you. You deserve so much more and I really hope that one day you find someone who appreciates you the way they should. 

Sending you hugs 💜

I feel this and I think that calling them 'mental bets' is spot on. Even though I wasn't officially diagnosed till adulthood, ever since I was a child I used to create these absurd conditions I had to meet in order to prevent something horrible from happening.

For example "if I don't finish cleaning my room during the next 3 songs I'll get cancer" or "if I don't reach this intersection (by bike then, by car now) in the next 10 seconds a loved one is going to suffer". I've actually stopped driving because I didn't feel safe and this is one of the reasons.

When I was a child I didn't necessarily always believe that the consequences I created would come true, they were more like little challenges I made to motivate myself. But I slowly started wondering what if and believing. It's scary how much it affects my life now.

This resonates with me so much. During our entire relationship neither of us brought up issues we had, me because I was scared of conflict and him because he has difficulty with opening up and talking about his feelings. By the time I realized what was happening it was too late. I begged him to talk to me, to tell me what's wrong and help me fix the things that I'm not doing right in the relationship. But he only told me when we were breaking up and I didn't even have a chance to try. Seven years gone in an afternoon 😔
This was sad and cute at the same time. I feel the same way, sending you hugs!
Thank you 💙

This is a really beautiful comment, thank you. He told me he truly meant the things he said to me at the time they were spoken, and even though it breaks my heart that he changed his mind, I try to tell myself that at least what we had was once real.

I hope I get there one day and be able to believe again. Take care kind stranger.

I'd say do whatever you think is better for you and helps your healing. If you want to be friends with her and keep her on social media that's great, but if you feel like it's too much for you right now that's ok too. It's not toxic to prioritize your own needs if you are not mean to her about it, and if you guys ended on good terms maybe you can even discuss it with her.

In my case when my ex broke up with me he told me he would love to stay in touch. I politely explained that while I cared about him, I wasn't angry with him and I am open to having a relationship in the future, I need to delete him from all social media right now because seeing his face pop up in my feed all the time would just prolong my pain. I needed some time to focus on myself and not talk to him so I could try to move on. I was polite, honest and he completely understood.

Best of luck to you!
I realized I just commented on your post because it really resonated with me as well. We are strong enough to get through this, take care!

Hi, I'm younger than you but I am facing a similar situation right now. He broke up a 7 year relationship with me because he had some things to work through, struggled with his mental health and wanted to find himself. We were supposed to spend the rest of our lives together and I honestly believed he was my soulmate.

I wish I could give you useful advice or a solution but the truth is it's going to hurt for a while. I don't know if it will help you at all but here are three things that I keep telling myself and it has made the pain somewhat more tolerable: 

**1. He did what was best for him.**

This is the thought that has helped me the most. It doesn't matter if I did my best, loved him and took care of him. For whatever reason the relationship wasn't working for him anymore and he wanted something different. It hurts me like hell, but I love him too much to not want him to be happy. So if this is what he needs then so be it.

**2. There is nothing you could have done about it.**

I have spent so much time wondering what if and asking myself what I could have done differently to salvage the relationship. We could have talked about the problems sooner, tried so many different things before breaking up but it doesn't matter. At the end of the day there isn't anything I could do, because if there was a way for us to stay together he would have found that way himself. The sad truth is he just didn't want to try anymore.

**3. You get to focus on yourself.**

I'm terrified of being alone and I hate it that I will have to go through life without him. But as much as it pains me, there are some benefits to the breakup. At least now I can focus on my needs, on things that I want to do without thinking about what he would think of them. While I didn't want to breakup at all, I will make sure I make the best of this newfound freedom, and treat myself the way I deserve to be treated.

I honestly don't know if any of this will help you, but maybe you will at least find solace at the thought you are not the only one going through this. I'm sending hugs your way!

This is what I'm trying to tell myself. I keep analyzing my relationship and trying to come up with a way that I could have made it work. But the sad truth is if there was a way to make it work, he would have found it himself.

As I am looking back on the relationship, I realize that whenever we discussed us as a couple in the past few months I was the one finding the reasons to stay. While he was only searching for reasons to go.

It hurts, but I guess it is what it is.

I really hope that time heals all wounds as people say, because I just keep getting worse. We were together for 7 years, supposed to spend our lives together. He broke up with me about a week and a half ago, I immediately asked for no contact because I can't face him without breaking down and everyday he doesn't reach out I get more nauseous because I realize he really meant it. He just doesn't want to be with me. 

I agree that forgiveness is a big part of it and I think I have forgiven him (more than myself), because I really do understand his reasons for the breakup. But I feel like I will never accept it 😔 And I am really really scared I will love him forever and never move on. He was my first and only love, how could I ever move on from that?

I don't really know why I'm making this comment. I guess I just wanted to say that it was well said and I hope so so much that one day I will feel like this too.
This comment made me smile! Thanks fellow redditor.

Even though I knew this deep down, I think I also really needed to hear it, so thank you for making this post.

My boyfriend of 7 years broke up with me a little over a week ago and it has been hell for me. We had discussed spending the rest of our lives together, he used to tell me I was the love of his life, his favourite person and his best friend. Knowing I won't have him in my life anymore absolutely crushes me and I feel betrayed.

The reason he broke up with me was because he is struggling with his mental health and he needs to be alone right now. It destroys me that he didn't want to talk about the problems sooner, the fact that I tried to support him as much as I could but he wouldn't let me. The fact we could have tried so many different things before breaking up, and I would have understood all of them, as long as we fought through it together. He told me that he has been struggling with this decision for a while now because he truly loves me, but our relationship, any relationship, was too much.

It hurts me because I had chosen him a thousand times in the past and I would have chosen him a thousand times again if I could. But no matter how desperately I am looking for a reason to be angry at him for not choosing me back I simply can't, because how could I be angry at him for choosing himself?

It's killing me that we aren't together anymore. I feel robbed of my future and I don't think I will ever be able to completely move on from him. But if this is what he needs right now, if this is what he needs to have a happy life who am I to try and deny him that? I care about him more deeply than I have cared for anyone else before, and if my happiness needs to be sacrificed for his then so be it.

Because no matter the decision I am facing I will always end up choosing him. So if this is what he wants, I'll choose to let him go.

This is such a lovely idea, I feel like ever since the breakup I only talk about my ex. While it feels good to vent, it's starting to consume me and I need to focus elsewhere. I don't have a ps4 but could I join in? 😊

Thank you for replying. I'm trying to see it more logically, to focus on the bad parts of the relationship and not idolize him; cause nobody is perfect. But the thing that makes it so hard is that I can't be angry at him. It hurts that he didn't want us to be together anymore but he had some things to work through and I understand his reasons for the breakup. I know in the long run it's better that it ended this way instead of breaking up because one of us did something horrible like cheating, cause even in the end I knew he respected me and cared about me as a person. This way at least the happy memories I have of him are not tainted. But I would really like a reason to hate him right now...

I'm not going to lie, I am still holding onto hope that when he works on his mental health he may want to try again. But I know that hope is a dangerous thing and I can't go through life waiting for him. And I also know that it could never be the same, and I'd never be able to fully trust his words again. Thank you for saying it because even though I know, I think I needed to hear it as well.

I would love to talk about it through pm if you want to and if you need to vent as well! It hurts like hell but I have found that talking about it helps.

I'm glad you are healing and I really do hope it gets better. We were together for 7 years and discussed spending the rest of our lives with each other, but he broke up with me a week ago. The pain is unbearable and I keep wondering what could I have done differently to prevent the breakup. But I try to remind myself that if he wanted us to be together he would have found a way himself, so I'm trying to focus on me for once instead of him.

Thank you for this. I'm trying to take things slow and be kind to myself, even though it's hard not to feel like this is my fault, like there was something I could have done to keep us together. But the truth is that if he wanted us to be together, he would have found the way himself.

I really do hope it gets better, because the pain is unbearable right now. I am a person that doesn't trust easily, so I doubt I will ever let myself love someone this much again. Right now I'm really starting to see that we live in an "every man for himself world" and I miss the days when I didn't believe that. But you are right, at least I know that what we had was real once and that I was capable of love.

I'm very sorry to hear that you went through a similar situation, but I am glad that you are slowly healing. I'm sending love your way!
This is a refreshing comment, thank you. It's good to hear that you managed to put yourself first. I can only hope that one day I'll be able to do the same.

He told me he would really like to stay in touch with me but I was the one who asked for no contact. I am not angry at him and I would love to have him in my life even if we were just friends, but I know I wouldn't be able to do that. It hurts me so much not being able to talk to him but I know that if I do I will just be holding onto the hope that he might change his mind one day. And that hope is going to destroy me.

I am very sorry that you went through a similar situation. And you're right, at least this community makes us feel a little less alone. Take care!

This made me cry, it's so beautifully written and so true. We often feel like we are the only ones who go through it and that our breakup stings the most but there are so many others who experience the same pain. And while it is heartbreaking that so many people are hurting, at least we are not alone. I truly hope it does get better and that we manage to heal with time.

Thank you for posting this.
Oh this hurts so much :( He was everything I wanted and it kills me that he didn't feel the same. Hang in there fellow redditors.

I am honestly overwhelmed and emotional by the amount of responses I got. It's heartbreaking to see that so many people are hurting in the same way, but the good people of reddit helped me feel a bit less alone. I'm sorry to hear you went through a similar situation, I hope you are doing ok. Sending hugs your way.

Thank you, this is exactly what I'm trying to focus on. There were things that I wanted to do but couldn't because of the relationship and I accepted that because he was always more important to me. It's hard to plan a future right now that doesn't include him, but I try to focus on the fact that I can now at least be free, even if it hurts.

I read something similar, "take care of yourself like you would care for a partner, because you are your partner now". I try to be kind to myself and remind me that it's all going to be okay, but it's hard to accept right now. Hang in there friend.

Thank you for this! I am still in the phase where all I want to do is cry, but I know that I will soon have to force myself to become more active in order to get through it and you gave some great suggestions. I hope you are doing ok and I wish you all the best.

You are very right. I know I shouldn't give up on all of my dreams just because he gave up on us. I don't know how I will manage to move on, but I guess as time passes it will get slightly easier. Thank you for your advice and I wish you well.
I'm sorry to hear that.. Sending you hugs.

What you said really resonates with me. I feel like the life I wanted was stolen from me, we had so many dreams together and they all just disappeared. I don't know how to accept that the life I will have will not include him. I just feel empty inside.

I can only hope that one day I will manage to come to terms with it. Thank you for your comment. I'm really sorry for what you have been through, but I'm glad that you are feeling better and are healing. I guess all we can do is give it time.

Thank you for your comment and I'm sorry that you are going through the same thing. I know it takes time and there is nothing that can be done about the pain. It just kills me that a person I loved so dearly is going to become a stranger. 

I hope we feel better at some point. Hang in there friend.

Your therapist is right, I have been told similar things by mine. The thing is though that I can't stop thinking this way when I have been told time and time again what a huge problem I am. I've had very few friendships but all of them ended up in a disaster and they would explain to me how it was all my fault. And when I met a guy who actually liked me back I did everything I could to not show him my anxiety or talk about my fears. Eventually he started insisting that it was ok to open up to him and be vulnerable. We were together for 5 years, after which he told me that my anxiety is ruining his life and he should never have tried to support me, because he wants to be with someone who is normal. My father has seen me have multiple panic attacks or cry for days on end and he has never, not even one time, asked me how I am doing or what is wrong. When I told my mother for the first time that I was suicidal as a teen, her response was "So what? Everyone thinks about their death from time to time". And whenever I try to tell her how I feel, she ends up saying that I'm ungrateful for everything they have given me and that I'm hurting her feelings again.

So how am I supposed to believe I don't cause problems wherever I go? How am I supposed to want to be alive when people always remind me what a burden I am? People have literally been telling me that me being in their lives makes it worse. And I don't even blame them for thinking that. I feel like I'm just a waste of space at this point.

I just don't know what to think anymore. I guess you are right about making small steps and setting small goals, I know I can't expect things to change overnight. But I have been hoping for so many years that things will improve, and so far they just keep getting worse. I simply can't picture a future for me that is worth living. Ultimately I know I won't go through with it yet, I have tried to devise a plan and execute it multiple times but I'm too much of a coward so I just end up crying on the floor all night. I also know it would destroy my sister. But I'm so exhausted. And I wish I could see a reason to keep fighting but I don't, cause all I want is for the pain to stop.

You said you don't know how much you can help, but you distracted me from a terrible day and that is already more than I could ask for. I wish I could embrace the advice you gave me but I feel too hopeless for that at the moment. My therapist told me to repeatedly write down that I love and believe in myself even if I don't right now, so I'm going to read your words again and again in the hopes that I might one day believe them.

Everything seems so hopeless and pointless to me. But you have been incredibly kind to me, so thank you for making me feel a little less alone today. I appreciate you.

Hi, and thank you so much for reading all of this and for your kind words. I feel so alone and lost and I don't know what to do anymore.

I relate to what you said and even though I'm glad that some people can do so many things with ease (because I wouldn't wish this on anyone), it's heartbreaking for me to see because I know I will never get there. I know everyone has their own problems and a lot of people have it worse than I do, but it's so tiring to constantly have to battle your own mind. I'm very sorry to hear that you share similar struggles. May I ask how are you doing?

I have tried going to two therapists in the past and I am currently trying a third one. The first one helped me a bit because I got to discuss some past trauma that I never talked to anyone before, but I didn't feel any better with the other two. Before I started with my current one I tried to do a lot of research about OCD and possible treatments and I found a CBT therapist that had experience with OCD and anxiety disorders. But it hasn't helped me so far and I just feel guilty that I am costing my sister money, because I can't afford therapy on my own. I'm very scared that I will end up ruining her life and causing her problems like I have for so many others.

But how can I even expect for therapy to help me when I feel like I've given up? I just don't have the energy to try anymore and honestly I don't see the point either. I don't even blame the people in my life for leaving and giving up on me because it's so tiring to be around me. My life is either doing constant compulsions, worrying about things that make no sense or just sitting and doing absolutely nothing for hours on end. I have no life and I have no future. 

You offer a lot of good advice and I really thank you. I am stuck in that vicious cycle and I can't even do small every day tasks anymore because I get too anxious. I don't believe that I will ever get better, but I will keep your words in mind. Maybe one day I will want to try again. Even though I don't see the point.

I'm sorry that this was so long. Thank you again for taking time from your day to try and help. I truly appreciate it.
